description: Bacteriophage lambda tL3, the rho-independent terminator of the major leftward (pL) operon just downstream of exo: 88 bp from the exo stop codon to the mapped termination point, carrying a GC-rich 8-bp-stem / 5-nt-loop hairpin followed by the sequence of the CCUUUCU 3' end.

references.title: Transcription termination: sequence and function of the rho-independent tL3 terminator in the major leftward operon of bacteriophage lambda.

label: tL3
note: Bacteriophage lambda tL3, the rho-independent terminator of the major leftward (pL) operon just downstream of exo: 88 bp from the exo stop codon to the mapped termination point, carrying a GC-rich 8-bp-stem / 5-nt-loop hairpin followed by the sequence of the CCUUUCU 3' end.

label: tL3 hairpin
note: GC-rich hairpin of tL3: two 8-bp arms (AGGCUGGG / CCCGGCCU, one G-U pair) around a 5-nt loop (UAUUU), as described by Luk & Szybalski 1982 ("2X8-bp symmetry ... with a 5-bp intervening loop"). Arms located on the sequence by that description.

label: tL3 3' end (CCUUUCU)
note: Pyrimidine-rich tract transcribed into the CCUUUCU-OH 3' end of the terminated RNA; the termination point follows the last U (S1-mapped, Luk & Szybalski 1982). It overlaps the hairpin's second arm by 3 bp.

provenance.sequence_source: Bacteriophage lambda tL3; lambda (J02459 / NC_001416) 31262-31347, complement, plus 2 bp (part 43-44) not in the lambda reference but present in the lab's tL3-carrying plasmids. The 3' end is base 31262, where NC_001416 ends the tL3-terminated pL mRNA. Re-delimited (2026-11) from a 272 bp record (lambda 31089-31358): the old part also carried the last 11 bp of exo (with its stop codon) and the 173 bp past the termination point (lambda 31089-31261, coding DNA of orf60a/orf63).

functional_claims.label: Spans lambda 31262-31347 (minus strand): from the base after the exo stop codon to the termination point after the CCUUUCU 3' end, which Luk & Szybalski mapped by S1 nuclease (the end is experimental). The start is not mapped by truncation: it is where the conventional "lambda tL3 terminator" annotation starts, 63 bp upstream of the hairpin (provisional).

source.quote: an 81% G+C-rich region of 2X8-bp symmetry ("stem") with a 5-bp intervening "loop", partially overlapping and followed by a sequence transcribed into the pyrimidine-rich CCUUUCU-OH 3' terminus of the RNA. The termination point that follows the last U was determined by the S1 mapping technique.
